title: app-showcase: record-action success messages name no record ("Task marked done.") — fails the write-feedback naming rule (ruling C on #25849); the runner fills {{ }} holes, so the copy can name the record
body:
Filing gate: ① a clause `fail` with a live reproduction (QA run, rule 2 checks done), product-defect disposition. The capability works, but the showcase's declared copy violates the ruled convention.
Business reason: a user who marks several tasks done in a row sees "Task marked done." each time and cannot tell which record changed. Maintainer ruling C on #25849 (comment 6417978207) says a record-level write names the record (its title) or the count. #26172 brought the console's create/update toasts in line; an action's authored `successMessage` is the showcase's own copy, and the console renders it verbatim.
Reader: the app-showcase fixture owner, `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): searched for "Task marked done", "showcase Mark Done success toast". The hits are different defects:
- #26172 (closed): console create/update toasts, not authored action copy.
- #25468 (closed): Mark Done permission.
reach: the console record header for any `showcase_task` with `done: false`. Measured on a fresh stock showcase boot at `756220c4` as admin.
Checklist item priority: P1
type: Bug
QA-source: #26456 · ux-conventions.write-feedback · acceptance[1]

## Reproduction
Reproduced twice on fresh loads, with ref-targeted clicks.
1. Boot the stock showcase and sign in as admin.
2. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/record/ID` for a task with `done: false` (e.g. "PII access review").
3. Click "Mark Done" in the page header actions. `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_task/showcase_mark_done` with `{"recordId":"ID","params":{}}` → 200; the row reads `done: true`.
4. The success toast reads **"Task marked done."**

**Expected** (`ux-conventions.write-feedback` acceptance[1], record-level class): the toast names the record (e.g. `Task "PII access review" marked done.`) or a count.

## Mechanism
- `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts:69` declares `successMessage: 'Task marked done.'`.
- The action runner fills `{{ }}` holes in an authored `successMessage` (`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`, the RUNNER_TEXT docblock around lines 627–630), so the declaration can name the record.
- The same file's other record-level messages name only the object as well: line 186 "Estimate recalculated.", line 482 "Task archived (demo — no data changed).", and line 332 "Invoice submitted for finance + legal sign-off.". They are worth fixing in the same pass. Line 242 (the selection-wide recalculation) could name its count.

Not confirmed: which hole syntax resolves the record title for a `perRecord` action (`{{record.title}}` vs another binding). Read `ActionRunner.ts` before choosing.
